Discover 10 different fish and fill your Fish Collection. Each new catch reveals a collection card, while repeat catches add to your total and bring you closer to unlocking another weapon.

Ready for a faster challenge? In Timed Shoot, fish jump from the water one after another. Choose a 30 or 60-second round, land as many shots as you can and see your catch count and accuracy at the end.

Features:

• Cast, reel and shoot in the main Fishing mode
• Manage line tension while reeling
• Aim at fish during their midair jump
• Play 30 or 60-second Timed Shoot rounds
• Discover 10 fish and track your collection
• Unlock four weapons as your catch total grows

Time your shot, discover every fish and keep building your collection.

newReleases.name: 台風予報から日本列島を逃がせ！-台風から逃げるゲーム
newReleases.desc:
「台風〇号が発生しました。今後の進路に警戒してください」
――だったら、日本列島のほうが逃げればいい。

天気予報の画面そっくりの地図の上で、次々に発生する台風から日本列島をドラッグで動かして逃げるゲームです。
ルールはひとつ。台風の赤い円（暴風域）に触れたら上陸＝ゲームオーバー。
何日生き延びられるかが、あなたの記録になります。

◆ あそび方はかんたん
・画面のどこでもドラッグすると、日本列島が同じ方向に動きます
・台風は白い点線の「予報進路」を出しながら近づいてきます。でも予報はあくまで予報。急に曲がってきます
・黄色い円（強風域）をかすめて逃げきると「ニアミス」ボーナス
・青い「H」（太平洋高気圧）を取ると、しばらく台風をはね返せます

◆ 台風はだんだん本気になる
・日にちが進むほど台風の数が増え、速く、しつこく追いかけてきます
・「強い」「非常に強い」台風は暴風域が大きい
・北へ抜けた台風は温帯低気圧に変わって消えます。うまく「やり過ごす」のがコツ

◆ 他の国に迷惑をかけないでください
逃げるのに夢中で日本列島を隣の国に押しつけると、「外交問題に発展」「国連が困惑」などの速報が流れます。
迷惑をかけた国の数は、最後にしっかり記録されます。

◆ 対戦モード（リアルタイム1対1）
友だちとルーム番号で、またはランダムで対戦。先に上陸したほうの負け（時間無制限）。
ニアミス2回で相手に「非常に強い台風」を送りつけたり、高気圧で相手の台風を加速させたり、予報円を消したり。相手の画面はミニ地図で見えます。相手が見つからなければコンピュータと対戦。

◆ 月間ランキング
ニックネームを登録して、「生き延びた日数」と「対戦ポイント」の2つの月間ランキングに挑戦。TOP100と自分の順位が見られます。毎月1日にリセット。

◆ 記録をシェア
ゲームオーバー画面から「〇日生き延びた・迷惑をかけた国：〇か国」を、LINE・X・メッセージなど好きなアプリに送れます。
友だちと日数を競ってみてください。

◆ スマホならではの遊び方
・「傾き操作」をオンにすると、スマホを傾けた向きに日本列島が動きます（ドラッグと併用できます）
・上陸・ニアミス・高気圧バリアの瞬間にスマホが振動
・ひとり用モードは通信なしで遊べます（ランキングと対戦だけインターネットを使います）
・月間ランキングの締め切り前日に通知でお知らせ（ランキング画面でオン／オフ）

◆ 天気予報番組そのもの
日付つきの台風情報、赤いテロップ、暴風域・強風域・予報円。
本物の気象情報ではなく、すべて架空のゲームです。実際の防災情報は気象庁などの公式情報をご確認ください。

地図：Natural Earth（パブリックドメイン）
台風の名前：気象庁「台風のアジア名」リストをもとにしています

newReleases.name: Bubble Connect - Word Match
newReleases.desc:
Match words and connect your way to a sharper brain!

Bubble Connect is a relaxing word association game where every word bubble hides a connection. Find the words that belong together, merge the bubbles by category and clear the board. Enjoy thousands of levels and play offline, wherever your day takes you!

Each level fills the screen with floating word bubbles. Some links are easy to spot, others will make you stop and think. Drag one bubble onto another to merge words of the same category and watch the board get lighter with every match. Connect all the words to complete the level!

HOW TO PLAY

• Look at the word bubbles on the board.
• Find words that share a category.
• Drag a word bubble onto another one to join words from the same group.
• Complete each category to clear it from the board.
• Keep connecting until every word bubble is gone to win the level.

A WORD ASSOCIATION GAME THAT MAKES YOU THINK

Bubble Connect is not a word search and not a crossword. It's a word association game built on logic: look at a group of words, find what they have in common and decide where each one belongs. newReleases.desc:

Capybara Wobble is the most relaxed nail-biter on the App Store: a capy swings on a rope, you tap at the right moment, and it lands (hopefully) on the tower. Sounds easy? The tower has real weight. Stack crooked and it topples. Stack perfectly and it straightens itself again.

updates.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
updates.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

updates.name: Yarn Loop: Knit Puzzle
updates.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

Welcome to Bus Crowd, a colorful bus puzzle game built around traffic jam strategy, passenger matching, and smart parking choices. 

A crowded station is full of waiting passengers, and buses with different colors and seat capacities are ready to roll. Check the crowd, choose the right vehicle, then move it into an available parking slot for boarding. Fill every seat to release that slot, avoid a parking jam, and keep each Bus Crowd under control.

How to Play
- Match Colors and Seats: Empty buses enter the boarding slots to pick up waiting passengers of the same color. Each vehicle has its own capacity, so compare the crowd before making a move.
- Follow the Arrows: Move buses from the station into parking slots. Each vehicle can only drive in its arrow direction, so blocked paths need careful observation.
- Fill Buses to Open Slots: A full vehicle departs and opens its parking space for another move. Avoid leaving buses that are not fully filled in the slots for too long.
- Solve the Jam with Strategy: Use color sort logic, bus sort thinking, and car parking style planning to handle every traffic puzzle. 
- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress. 

Game Features
- Bus Jam Puzzle Fun: Mix color matching, passenger boarding, parking slots, and traffic jam choices in a challenge that feels easy to start and satisfying to solve.

all.name: 台風予報から日本列島を逃がせ！-台風から逃げるゲーム
all.desc:
「台風〇号が発生しました。今後の進路に警戒してください」
――だったら、日本列島のほうが逃げればいい。

天気予報の画面そっくりの地図の上で、次々に発生する台風から日本列島をドラッグで動かして逃げるゲームです。
ルールはひとつ。台風の赤い円（暴風域）に触れたら上陸＝ゲームオーバー。
何日生き延びられるかが、あなたの記録になります。

◆ あそび方はかんたん
・画面のどこでもドラッグすると、日本列島が同じ方向に動きます
・台風は白い点線の「予報進路」を出しながら近づいてきます。でも予報はあくまで予報。急に曲がってきます
・黄色い円（強風域）をかすめて逃げきると「ニアミス」ボーナス
・青い「H」（太平洋高気圧）を取ると、しばらく台風をはね返せます

◆ 台風はだんだん本気になる
・日にちが進むほど台風の数が増え、速く、しつこく追いかけてきます
・「強い」「非常に強い」台風は暴風域が大きい
・北へ抜けた台風は温帯低気圧に変わって消えます。うまく「やり過ごす」のがコツ

◆ 他の国に迷惑をかけないでください
逃げるのに夢中で日本列島を隣の国に押しつけると、「外交問題に発展」「国連が困惑」などの速報が流れます。
迷惑をかけた国の数は、最後にしっかり記録されます。

◆ 対戦モード（リアルタイム1対1）
友だちとルーム番号で、またはランダムで対戦。先に上陸したほうの負け（時間無制限）。
ニアミス2回で相手に「非常に強い台風」を送りつけたり、高気圧で相手の台風を加速させたり、予報円を消したり。相手の画面はミニ地図で見えます。相手が見つからなければコンピュータと対戦。

◆ 月間ランキング
ニックネームを登録して、「生き延びた日数」と「対戦ポイント」の2つの月間ランキングに挑戦。TOP100と自分の順位が見られます。毎月1日にリセット。

◆ 記録をシェア
ゲームオーバー画面から「〇日生き延びた・迷惑をかけた国：〇か国」を、LINE・X・メッセージなど好きなアプリに送れます。
友だちと日数を競ってみてください。

◆ スマホならではの遊び方
・「傾き操作」をオンにすると、スマホを傾けた向きに日本列島が動きます（ドラッグと併用できます）
・上陸・ニアミス・高気圧バリアの瞬間にスマホが振動
・ひとり用モードは通信なしで遊べます（ランキングと対戦だけインターネットを使います）
・月間ランキングの締め切り前日に通知でお知らせ（ランキング画面でオン／オフ）

◆ 天気予報番組そのもの
日付つきの台風情報、赤いテロップ、暴風域・強風域・予報円。
本物の気象情報ではなく、すべて架空のゲームです。実際の防災情報は気象庁などの公式情報をご確認ください。

all.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

all.name: Yarn Loop: Knit Puzzle
all.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

all.name: Bus Crowd - Traffic Jam
all.desc:
Welcome to Bus Crowd, a colorful bus puzzle game built around traffic jam strategy, passenger matching, and smart parking choices. 

A crowded station is full of waiting passengers, and buses with different colors and seat capacities are ready to roll. Check the crowd, choose the right vehicle, then move it into an available parking slot for boarding. Fill every seat to release that slot, avoid a parking jam, and keep each Bus Crowd under control.

How to Play
- Match Colors and Seats: Empty buses enter the boarding slots to pick up waiting passengers of the same color. Each vehicle has its own capacity, so compare the crowd before making a move.
- Follow the Arrows: Move buses from the station into parking slots. Each vehicle can only drive in its arrow direction, so blocked paths need careful observation.
- Fill Buses to Open Slots: A full vehicle departs and opens its parking space for another move. Avoid leaving buses that are not fully filled in the slots for too long.
- Solve the Jam with Strategy: Use color sort logic, bus sort thinking, and car parking style planning to handle every traffic puzzle. 
- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress. 

Game Features
- Bus Jam Puzzle Fun: Mix color matching, passenger boarding, parking slots, and traffic jam choices in a challenge that feels easy to start and satisfying to solve.

all.name: Fate/Grand Order (English)
all.desc:
A new mobile "Fate RPG," presented by TYPE-MOON!
With an impressive main scenario and multiple character quests, 
the game features millions of words of original story!
Packed with content that both fans of the Fate franchise and newcomers will be able to enjoy.

Summary

2017 A.D. 
Chaldea, an organization tasked with observing Earth's future, has confirmed that human history will be eliminated at 2019. 
Without warning, the promised future of 2017 disappeared.
Why? How? Who? By what means?
AD. 2004. A certain provincial town in Japan.
For the first time ever, a region that could not be observed appeared.
Assuming that this was the cause of humanity’s extinction, Chaldea carried out its sixth experiment - time travel into the past.
A forbidden ceremony where they would convert humans into Spiritrons and send them back in time. By intervening in events, they would locate, identify, and destroy the space-time Singularities.
The mission classification is an order to protect Humanity: Grand Order.
This is the title for those who would take a stand against human history and battle fate in order to protect mankind.

Game Introduction

A command card battle RPG optimized for smart phones! 
Players become Masters and together with Heroic Spirits, defeat enemies and solve the mystery of human history's disappearance. 
It's up the players to form a party with their favorite Heroic Spirits - both new and old.

all.name: Colony Flow!
all.desc:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more s
